topic: How does the hierarchical classification framework impact satellite link budget margins when prioritizing QoS-sensitive traffic?
consensus_response: Hierarchical classification optimizes link utilization by prioritizing QoS-sensitive traffic, allocating resources based on capacity requirements. However, it may compromise performance due to neglected latency and jitter considerations. Beamforming and adaptive coding techniques enhance link capacity, while advanced channel estimation improves modeling accuracy, optimizing budget margins.
reference_context: QoS-provisioning in converged satellite and terrestrial networks requires managing high fixed latencies and providing QoS guarantees through traffic classification and resource allocation.
